name: mod-hud
description: A side pane, toggled by /mod-hud: a HUD of the session (header, alerts, then session, context and prompt cache, limits, usage and todos in labelled sections) above every subagent in it (type, model, status, elapsed time, tool calls, current tool, result), with an opt-in status line; the session's own mascot lives in the band above the prompt and tidies the conversation up (compacts it) when its context has grown; in the desktop app and in Ghostty or kitty the mascots are smooth vector art.

stalledAfterSec.title: Stalled after (s)
stalledAfterSec.description: A running subagent with no activity for this many seconds is drawn as stalled.

statusLine.title: Status line summary
statusLine.description: Show the HUD and a count of running, done, failed and stalled subagents as one line in the status line.

maxRows.title: Most agents listed
maxRows.description: The pane lists at most this many subagents and workflow agents together and counts the rest; each group lists its running agents and its three most recent finished ones until expanded.

showGit.title: Show git
showGit.description: Show the branch in the HUD's session section: dirty mark, commits ahead and behind, lines changed against HEAD and the last commit's age.

showTools.title: Show tools
showTools.description: Show the HUD's session · now row: the main conversation's tool running now, its main argument and elapsed time. The files edited (Session tab, Overview) are counted either way.

showTodos.title: Show todos
showTodos.description: Show the main conversation's todo list under the HUD: a progress row and the item in progress, which its ▸ opens to every item.

showInventory.title: Show the inventory in /mod-hud facts
showInventory.description: Print the context breakdown's MCP servers and skills in /mod-hud facts. The breakdown is read either way, at most every five minutes, for the auto-compact threshold that marks the context bar and bounds the compaction runway. Since 1.2.0 the HUD no longer draws the MCP and skill counts.

motto.title: Motto
motto.description: A line drawn dim as the HUD's last row; empty (the default) for none.

mascots.title: Mascots
mascots.description: Fill the pane's spare rows with Claude mascots: the session's own, and one per subagent in its own colour, which its name in the list shares.

character.title: Mascot character
character.description: clawd (default): Claude Code's Clawd, each agent in its own colour with its role letter and an accessory. usagi: Usagi from Chiikawa (fan art), pale yellow, each agent's role shown by its hat (worker a construction hat, Explore or researcher a fedora, reviewer a mortarboard, debugger a miner's helmet, Plan a top hat, frontend a beret) and the session's by a crown on the side of its head.

showWorkflows.title: Show workflow agents
showWorkflows.description: Track the agents a Workflow run starts, which the agent list never names, and show them under the subagents, in the summary and as mascots.

inspect.title: Click to inspect
inspect.description: A button on every agent row, on the session's row and on every mascot opens its inspect view under the HUD: an agent's task, every tool call, its last answers; the session's overview and its cost by model and agent.

inspectView.title: Inspect view
inspectView.description: tv (default): pressing a mascot (or an agent's row) sends it to the pane's centre, where it grows into a TV of itself: the screen on its forehead shows the agent's tabs (Task, Trail, Said, Agents; the session's Overview, Cost, Agents), its left panel's knob and ◀ ▶ change channel (tab), its right panel's knob and ▲ ▼ scroll, as do the arrow keys and the wheel; its ✕ or a press anywhere else switches it off and sends it home, shaken for three seconds. Where the surface cannot (mobile, VS Code) or the pane is too small, the inspect view under the HUD. pane: always the inspect view under the HUD.

wander.title: Mascots wander
wander.description: Mascots between tools walk about their line, hop and, with a spare row above, glide.

scenes.title: Orchestration scenes
scenes.description: Mascots act out real events: handing a task over, handing a report back, messages, review and fix visits, and a workflow squad's baton.

collisions.title: Mascot collisions
collisions.description: off: wanderers that meet step back; rare (default): only two moving mascots collide, falling over dizzy, at most once per pair in 30 s; normal: a moving mascot knocks over a standing one too, once per pair in 10 s. In rare and normal a thrown mascot knocks over whoever it hits.

motion.title: Mascot motion
motion.description: smooth (default): where the surface can (terminal, desktop), the scene runs in its own module at 20 frames a second, gliding between cells, and mascots can be clicked to inspect or picked up, dragged and thrown; classic: the Box/Text scene at 4 frames a second everywhere, with a pick button under each mascot.

mascotArt.title: Mascot art
mascotArt.description: vector (default): in the desktop app, and in Ghostty or kitty (known by their own environment variables, never under tmux), the mascots are drawn shapes that move smoothly at 30 frames a second, every pose eased into the next; blocks: the block characters there too. Other terminals (macOS Terminal, Windows Terminal) and VS Code draw the blocks either way, as does a terminal that refuses a picture. Needs motion smooth.

todoRows.title: Most todos listed
todoRows.description: Opened, the TODO section lists at most this many items and counts the rest.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto (default): infer the main conversation's prompt-cache TTL as Claude Code picks it (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H on any provider and ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H_BEDROCK on Bedrock honoured; else 5m on an API key, auth token, apiKeyHelper or partner cloud, 1h otherwise). Where the mod cannot tell (a Console API-key login, a subscription drawing on usage credits past its limits, a base URL that may be a gateway) the TTL is drawn as a guess, (1h?). 5m or 1h: count down that instead, as certain.

sessionMascot.title: Session mascot
sessionMascot.description: band (default): the session's own mascot lives in the band above the prompt, where the surface draws one (terminal, desktop), so it shows with the HUD closed too; the subagents stay in the pane, and clicking the mascot opens the HUD on the session's view. Where no band is drawn (VS Code, mobile) it stays in the pane. pane: in the pane's scene with the subagents, as before 1.4.0.

tidy.title: Tidy up
tidy.description: Compacting the main conversation once its context passes Tidy up at. ask (default): the band offers it while the main loop is idle, with how many requests it takes to pay for itself; Tidy up runs it (the same call /compact makes, told to keep the plan and the todos), Not now puts it off until the context grows 50k more. auto: after a main turn ends with no subagent running, the band counts down ten seconds, then tidies up; Not now or a new prompt stops it. off: never offered. Whatever this says, the session's mascot squashes a pile of pages while any compaction of the main conversation runs, and the band shows its size before and after.

tidyAt.title: Tidy up at (k tokens)
tidyAt.description: The context, in thousands of tokens, past which a tidy is offered (or, with tidy auto, started). Never under 40. Roughly 100 to 200 costs least for most long sessions: earlier and the summaries cost more than they save, later and every request re-reads a large context.
